wiki.title: Francis C. Thompson
wiki.extract: Francis C. Thompson (born October 29, 1941) is an American educator and politician who has represented District 19 in the Louisiana House of Representatives since 2020. He previously represented the district from 1975 until 2008 and represented District 34 in the Louisiana State Senate from 2008 until 2020.
